description: This file defines the AzureBasedReminderTable class implementing the IReminderTable interface. It manages reminder entries in Azure Table storage, providing methods to start, stop, read, upsert, and delete reminder data, as well as internal conversion between table entries and reminder objects. It includes detailed logging for various operations and error handling.

classes.name: AzureBasedReminderTable
classes.description: A class that manages reminder entries in Azure Table storage, implementing start, stop, read, update, and delete functionalities with logging and error handling.

methods.name: StartAsync
methods.description: Initializes the Azure table for reminders, retrying on failure until success or cancellation.

methods.name: StopAsync
methods.description: Cancels initialization and completes the task.

methods.name: TestOnlyClearTable
methods.description: Clears all entries in the reminder table, used for testing.

methods.name: ReadRows
methods.description: Reads reminder entries for a specific grain ID.

methods.name: ReadRows
methods.description: Reads reminder entries within a range of sequence numbers.

methods.name: ReadRow
methods.description: Reads a specific reminder entry for a grain ID and reminder name.

methods.name: UpsertRow
methods.description: Inserts or updates a reminder entry in the table.

methods.name: RemoveRow
methods.description: Removes a specific reminder entry based on grain ID, reminder name, and ETag, conditionally.
